Hardside Luggage

Finding the right suitcase shouldn’t be hard, so shop Marshalls’ amazing selection of hard case [luggage](https://www.marshalls.com/us/store/shop/beauty-accessories-beauty-accessories-luggage-travel/_/N-2090684452). You’ll find items by top brands at prices you won’t believe! Looking for a hard shell suitcase that holds up to travel? Or maybe you need a hard case luggage set for trips of all sizes. No matter where your epic adventures take you, these hard-shell luggage sets will go the distance. Premium materials like Italian leather, high-quality hardware, and spinner wheels make these must-have items. Score a hard suitcase with wheels that makes navigating the airport a breeze! Whether you [carry on](https://www.marshalls.com/us/store/shop/beauty-accessories-beauty-accessories-luggage-travel-carry-on-luggage/_/N-3884517350) or [check your bags](https://www.marshalls.com/us/store/shop/beauty-accessories-beauty-accessories-luggage-travel-checked-luggage/_/N-1515559172), you’ll find your perfect flight match.

While you’re at it, you can also browse [soft side luggage](https://www.marshalls.com/us/store/shop/beauty-accessories-beauty-accessories-luggage-travel-softside-luggage/_/N-413702616)! Check out [weekenders and duffels](https://www.marshalls.com/us/store/shop/beauty-accessories-beauty-accessories-luggage-travel-weekenders-duffels/_/N-2813231951) for those quick trips and [shoulder bags](https://www.marshalls.com/us/store/shop/womens-shoulder-bags/_/N-827530852) to keep essentials at the ready. And don’t forget [travel accessories](https://www.marshalls.com/us/store/shop/beauty-accessories-beauty-accessories-luggage-travel-travel-accessories/_/N-2700115071), like neck pillows and toiletry organizers. With Marshalls’ incredible selection of hardside luggage and more, you’ll be all set to hit the road!
